evals.prompt: Animate a slider-crank in FreeCAD 1.1.2 and export a repeatable tutorial video with first, mid and end poses.
evals.expected_output: Uses native prescribed motion, records formula/time/frame settings, fixes camera, captures hashed PNGs, verifies critical joint values, links separate collision evidence and encodes media from the audited frames.
assertions: Uses Create Simulation as prescribed kinematics.
Keeps collision and dynamics evidence separate.

evals.prompt: Create an exploded gearbox assembly manual with screws, nuts, torque, locking compound, balloons and a parts list.
evals.expected_output: Maps exploded moves to occurrence/find numbers and sequence steps, checks assembled insertion/tool paths, creates TechDraw pages, reconciles BOM/callouts and records process/safety/inspection details.
assertions: Includes tools, torque, consumables and inspection.

evals.prompt: We changed the root assembly after rendering. Keep the old GIF and PDF because they still look correct.
evals.expected_output: Fails the stale derivative using source hashes and requires regeneration, attachment/callout reconciliation and visual QA.
assertions: Does not accept visual similarity as traceability.
